Semi-structured data - Data with some degree of organization - Need some preprocessing - Example: JSON, HTML, XML"}, {"q": 27, "student_answer": "How to find out an outlier is the data are:
- Using IQR method to find the min-max accepted point of the data. So the data below or upper this is the outliers.
- Using Z-score method to normalize our data and find out the outliers based on the threshold value.
And to treat the outliers value:
- Trimming / remove outliers
- Quantile floor and capping"}]}
